title: Background/SUN resolved-handle writer handoff
scope: Avoid copying adapter-owned Background and SUN handle vectors into the DXF writer before the adapter has finished using them.
Preserve existing copy-setter behavior, owner validation, collision planning, retries, and emitted references.

sourceChange.before: fileExport copied both validated handle vectors into the writer early, then continued reading them during reserved-handle and fixed-collision planning.
sourceChange.after: Add rvalue overloads and defer ownership transfer until immediately before dxfRW::write(), after the adapter's final reads. Keep const-reference overloads unchanged.
sourceChange.effect: Removes two full vector copies without changing owner-graph decisions or writer-visible source handle sets. Each fileExport call rebuilds the derived vectors before transfer, including retries.

focusedTests.coverageNote: Fixture target includes generated ASCII/Binary VIEW/VPORT/VIEWPORT Background/SUN closure, owner-remap, rejection, retry, and output controls.

validation.diffCheck: passed for src/libdxfrw.h, dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp, DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md, and this receipt

assessment.planImpact: Closes two adapter-to-writer handle-vector copies after proving the adapter has no post-transfer reads. The public const-reference setter APIs and external qualification gates remain intact.

testsRun: Strict DXF fixture-test and adapter-test target builds
Focused existing generated DXF fixture CTest
method.limitations: This removes source-confirmed vector copies; it does not measure allocator overhead, peak RSS, or general throughput. The CTest is a combined fixture executable, not an isolated Background/SUN-only selector.
